svg.title: iOS · Guided clip (experimental) · canvas step · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/GuidedBuilderView.swift (canvasStep) — the first step of the experimental guided builder, reached from the "Guided clip (experimental)" button on a video project's detail page (ProjectDetailView, sets AppModel.guidedBuilderFocused after openCapture) or LL_GUIDED=latest. The flow replaces AdjustView for this pass through stage == .configure; same warp + reframe data underneath, so everything round-trips into the full editor. Chrome shared by every step: FlowHeader "Guided clip" with back chevron (back pops one step; on this first step it exits via model.reset()) and an EXPERIMENTAL capsule (9pt bold, kerning 0.5, LL.accent on accent-12%); step dots under the header — one capsule per step (canvas + one per stretch + review), filled accent up to the current step, current one wider (18×5 vs 7×5); primary Next button pinned at the bottom (LLPrimaryButtonStyle). Canvas step content: 22pt bold question "What shape should the clip be?", the shared CanvasRatioChips row (16:9 · 9:16 · 1:1 · 4:3 · 3:4, selected solid accent — here 9:16, the as-shot shape of the portrait reference capture), then two 11.5pt secondary captions: the consequence line ("9:16 — as shot", or "1:1 — crops to 2160×2160" via VideoCanvasCropper.cropSize) and "Asked first because every framing is composed against this shape." Selection writes AppModel.blendCanvasRatio; framings authored later are clamped against this shape. Not drawn: the other ratio selections and their consequence lines. Captured from the iPhone 17 Pro sim (402×874 pt) and mapped onto the 393×852 template canvas.
